# Inlet Cartridge Filter F1 — Full Technical Extraction

---

## Section 2 — Inlet Cartridge Filter F1

---

### 2.1 Function

- Filter designation: **F1**
- Filter type: **20 micron pleated cartridge**
- Operating principle: Particles collect on the cartridge during operation
- Monitored parameter: **filter_dp** (differential pressure across filter)
- Behavior: filter_dp rises with the volume filtered

---

### 2.2 Limits

| Condition | Parameter | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Clean cartridge at rated flow | filter_dp | **0.10 bar** |
| Warning W-21 threshold | filter_dp | **above 0.60 bar** |
| Alarm A-22 threshold | filter_dp | **above 0.80 bar** |

- **Warning code: W-21** — Description: "Filter clogging" — Trigger: filter_dp above **0.60 bar**
- **Alarm code: A-22** — Description: "Filter blocked" — Trigger: filter_dp above **0.80 bar** — Action required: Replace the cartridge

---

### 2.3 Service

**Replacement interval:**
- Every **2000 operating hours**, OR
- Earlier when **alarm A-22 is active**

**Typical cartridge life:**
- At rated flow and normal water quality: **2000 to 3000 operating hours**

**Reduced cartridge life condition:**
- High particle load (example: after mains repair work) — life can shorten to **500 operating hours**

---

### 2.4 Effect on the Pump

- A clogged filter **lowers the pump inlet pressure**
- Critical threshold: below **0.5 bar inlet pressure**
- Below 0.5 bar inlet pressure: pump **may cavitate**
- Effects of cavitation:
  - Raises **vibration_rms**
  - Accelerates **impeller wear**

---
